Topics · Prayer and closeness to God

Is God near even when I feel nothing?

Nearness in the Quran is a report about God, not your feeling: He has not left, He is with you, He answers.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you].

Quran · Ad-Duha 93:3

Translation

Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble. Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

Original · Hebrew

וִ֘יהִ֤י יְהוָ֣ה מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לַדָּ֑ךְ מִ֝שְׂגָּ֗ב לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃ וְיִבְטְח֣וּ בְ֭ךָ יוֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־עָזַ֖בְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃

the Psalms · 9:9-10

World English Bible

In the verse God says to His Prophet: your Lord has neither left you nor despised you. Two negatives: no abandoning and no hatred. The verse names no time or cause. It is a sentence from God about His stance toward one who, commentators say, felt cut off. You need not be a prophet to read what it holds: it is a report of God's stance, not of the listener's.

A question for you

Which is nearest to where you are?

If you sayI call and feel nothing.
ThenThe verse does not make feeling the measure of nearness. The next steps say more.
If you sayI fear God is angry with me.
ThenThe verse denies abandonment and hatred in so many words. Read it slowly once more.
If you sayI went through a loss and stopped speaking.
ThenThere is a quiet page for someone who has lost. You need not speak to read it.

Part 2 of 3

﴿هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne.[1627] He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you[1628] wherever you are. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

Translator's notes

[1627] See footnotes to 2:19 and 7:54. [1628] In knowledge - observing and witnessing.

Quran · Al-Hadid 57:4

Translation

There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

Original · Ancient Greek

καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν κτίσις ἀφανὴς ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, πάντα δὲ γυμνὰ καὶ τετραχηλισμένα τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ, πρὸς ὃν ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος.

Hebrews · 4:13

World English Bible

The verse says God is with you wherever you are, and sees what you do. 'Wherever' includes the days you sense nothing. It includes a quiet room and a prayer with no taste. The nearness in the verse does not depend on your feeling it. It is a report about God, said as it is, whether or not you sense anything.

A question for you

What seems lighter to you now?

If you sayThat nearness is not a feeling.
ThenYes. The verse states the nearness and does not mention feeling.
If you sayTo keep going without a feeling.
ThenMany do. It is not failure.
If you sayI do not believe that yet.
ThenIt is enough to read. The last page is waiting.

Part 3 of 3

﴿وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ ۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And when My servants ask you, [O Muḥammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:186

Translation

Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

Original · Hebrew

קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃

the Psalms · 145:18

World English Bible

The verse says God is near and answers the call of the one who calls. It does not say He answers in the manner and time you expect. 'I answer' is a present-tense verb: it renews. And an answer is not always a feeling or a voice. It may be an arrangement of things, a patience given, a door closed. This page does not claim to know in every case, and there is a page on prayer that does not seem answered.

A question for you

What do you take from this page?

If you sayTo keep speaking.
ThenThat is what the verse invites: that the caller call.
If you sayTo look for the answer in other than feeling.
ThenAn idea worth quiet reflection. The page on unanswered prayer waits for you.
If you sayTo talk to someone about this.
ThenMany do this and find ease in it.

The same in the other books

Translation

‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

קְרָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וְאֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ וְאַגִּ֧ידָה לְּךָ֛ גְּדֹל֥וֹת וּבְצֻר֖וֹת לֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃

Jeremiah · 33:3

Translation

Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you. For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.
